Driving

DRIFT

Turn a controlled slide into charge, score and a better exit.

Turn a controlled slide into charge, score and a better exit.

What it does

DRIFT lets the car slide and refills BOOST. Once DRIFT ATTACK unlocks, a successful slide also earns points.

How to do it

Steer into a bend while holding DRIFT. Control the angle, then return to GAS as you straighten or link into the next slide.

Why use it

Trade some immediate speed for a tighter rotation, charge or scoring. DRIFT is slower than GAS; use it with a purpose.

Timing

Start with enough room to build a slide. Release before the angle carries you beyond the exit.

Advanced

LOCK strengthens the slide. A full BOOST bar lets further drifting build OVERCHARGE after its unlock. On GAS, catch that charge before it leaks.

Practise it

Try Cliffside. Tutorials give you a guided starting point.
